trailhead.label: Passo Oclini / Jochgrimm car park, the APT’s start

cautions: A forest road closed to private cars, but used by farm and hut vehicles.
The way back crosses open pasture where cows graze in summer: keep your dog on the lead and give the herd room.
About 160 m on the pass road at the start and end.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
